summary: This bill amends 18 U.S.C. § 1033(f)(1)(A) to extend the federal prohibition on insurance-related fraud to include the posting of monetary bail, criminal bail bonds, and federal immigration bail bonds.

scores.thoughts: This bill directly impacts the criminal justice system by regulating entities involved in bail, potentially making it harder for some defendants to secure release. This leans towards stricter justice by limiting avenues for bail.
